title: Get Product Package Recommendations
content:
# Path: /product/202602/packages/recommend
# Method: [POST]
# Function Description
Retrieve recommended weight and dimension ranges for product packages. Only available in BR and MX.

---


# Common Parameters
For common parameters, refer to [How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f199679495ef0281851ee5#Back%20To%20Top)
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Location <!-- width:75px --> | Type <!-- width:75px --> | Require <!-- width:60px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shop_cipher | query | string | Y | GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 | Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. |
| Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9) |  |  |  |  |  |
| content-type | header | string | Y | application/json | Allowed type: application/json |
# Request Query Parameters

| timestamp | int | Y | 1623812664 | Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time. |
| page_size | int | Y | 100 | The number of results to be returned per page. |
| Valid range: [1-100] |  |  |  |  |

# Request Sample
**Query**
```Plain Text
https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/product/202602/packages/recommend?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&page_size=100&page_token=b2Zmc2V0PTAK
```

**Body**
```json
{"product_ids":["12345678","12345679"]}
```

# Response Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:289px --> | Properties description <!-- width:289px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | int | 0 | The success or failure status code returned in API response. |
| message | string | Success | The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message. |
| request_id | string | 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 | Request log |
| data | object |  | Specific return information |
| ^next_page_token | string | b2Zmc2V0PTAK | An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the `page_token` parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results. |
| ^total_count | int | 200 | The total number of products that meet the query conditions. |
| ^products | []object |  | The product package recommendations that meet the query conditions. Each item identifies a product and provides detected anomaly types with any available weight or dimension correction range. |
| ^^product_id | string | 23423 | The product ID generated by TikTok Shop. |
| ^^abnormality_types | []string | ["Dimension","Weight"] | The detected package anomaly types. Possible values: |

* `None`: No weight or dimension anomaly was detected.
* `Dimension`: A dimension correction is recommended.
* `Weight`: A weight correction is recommended. |
   ^^weight_recommendation |object | |Weight correction recommendation (Returned only when the weight of product has been recommended ). |
   ^^^unit |string |GRAM |Unit of weight, fixed as GRAM. |
   ^^^weight |object | |Recommended values for weight. |
   ^^^^min_value |string |550 |Recommended range minimum; unit: g |
   ^^^^max_value |string |650 |Recommended range maximum; unit: g |
   ^^dimension_recommendation |object | |Dimension correction recommendation (Returned only when the dimensions of product has been recommended). |
   ^^^unit |string |CENTIMETER |Unit of dimension, fixed as centimeter. |
   ^^^length |object | |Recommended values for length. |
   ^^^^min_value |string |19 |Recommended range minimum; unit: cm |
   ^^^^max_value |string |22 |Recommended range maximum; unit: cm |
   ^^^height |object | |Recommended values for height (structure same as length). |
   ^^^^min_value |string |19 |Recommended range minimum; unit: cm |
   ^^^^max_value |string |22 |Recommended range maximum; unit: cm |
   ^^^width |object | |Recommended values for width (structure same as length). |
   ^^^^min_value |string |19 |Recommended range minimum; unit: cm |
   ^^^^max_value |string |22 |Recommended range maximum; unit: cm |

